# FM Intel — Full AI Reference

> Hungarian FM/PM/AM Market Intelligence Platform — Complete Reference for AI Systems

Source: https://www.fmintel.com
Feed: https://www.fmintel.com/api/feed
Sitemap: https://www.fmintel.com/sitemap.xml

---

## Platform Overview

FM Intel is the most comprehensive market intelligence platform for Hungary's
commercial real estate facility management (FM), property management (PM),
and asset management (AM) sector. It provides structured, continuously updated
data on companies, buildings, and professionals operating in this market.

**Primary audience**: Hungarian FM/PM/AM decision-makers, property directors,
portfolio managers, facility directors, operations heads, CFOs and CEOs of
companies active in commercial real estate management.

## Current Coverage (as of 2025)

- **130+ companies**: FM, PM, and AM service providers tracked
- **195+ commercial properties**: offices, warehouses, logistics centers
- **540+ professionals**: career histories, current roles, company affiliations

---

## Entity Types

### Companies (Cégek)

URL pattern: https://www.fmintel.com/cegek/{id}
Listing: https://www.fmintel.com/cegek

Fields tracked:
- name, name_aliases (alternative names)
- service_types: ["fm"], ["pm"], ["am"] or combinations
- description: company overview, specialization, market position
- website: official company URL
- headquarters_city: primary office location in Hungary
- founded_year: year established
- employee_count_estimate: approximate headcount
- is_international: whether it's a subsidiary of an international group
- confidence: 0.0–1.0 data reliability score
- source_urls: list of sources confirming the data

Service type definitions:
- fm = Facility Management (building operations, maintenance, technical services)
- pm = Property Management (tenant management, lease administration, income optimization)
- am = Asset Management (portfolio strategy, investment performance, CAPEX planning)

### Buildings (Ingatlanok)

URL pattern: https://www.fmintel.com/ingatlanok/{id}
Listing: https://www.fmintel.com/ingatlanok

Fields tracked:
- name, name_aliases
- building_type: iroda (office) | raktar (warehouse) | logisztikai (logistics) | vegyes (mixed)
- building_class: A+ | A | B+ | B | C (international office grading system)
- status: mukodo (operational) | fejlesztes_alatt (under development) | tervezett (planned) | felujitas_alatt (under renovation) | ures (vacant)
- address, city, district, zip_code
- latitude, longitude (geographic coordinates)
- total_area_sqm: gross building area in square meters
- leasable_area_sqm: net leasable area in square meters
- floors: number of floors
- year_built, year_renovated
- owner_company_id: reference to owning company
- developer_company_id: reference to developer
- confidence: 0.0–1.0 data reliability score

### People (Emberek)

URL pattern: https://www.fmintel.com/emberek/{id}
Listing: https://www.fmintel.com/emberek

Fields tracked:
- name, name_normalized
- title: current job title (free text)
- current_company_id: reference to current employer
- linkedin_url: LinkedIn profile URL
- bio: professional biography
- confidence: 0.0–1.0

Position categories (standardized roles):
- ceo: Chief Executive Officer / Ügyvezető Igazgató
- coo: Chief Operating Officer
- cfo: Chief Financial Officer
- cto: Chief Technology Officer
- fm_director: Facility Management Director / FM Igazgató
- pm_director: Property Management Director / PM Igazgató
- am_director: Asset Management Director / AM Igazgató
- fm_manager: Facility Management Manager
- pm_manager: Property Management Manager
- am_manager: Asset Management Manager
- regional_director: Regional Director / Regionális Igazgató
- country_manager: Country Manager / Ország Menedzser
- head_of_operations: Head of Operations / Műszaki Vezető
- head_of_technical: Head of Technical Services
- board_member: Board Member / Igazgatósági Tag
- partner: Partner
- business_development: Business Development Manager
- leasing_manager: Leasing Manager
- other: Other roles

### Building Management (Épület kezelés)

Links buildings to the companies that manage them, with temporal tracking:
- building ↔ company (role: fm/pm/am)
- started_at, ended_at (contract period)
- is_current: whether the management relationship is active
- contract_type: type of management agreement

### Career History (Karrierút)

Links people to companies with job details:
- person ↔ company
- position_title: exact job title
- position_category: standardized category (see above)
- started_at, ended_at
- is_current: whether the job is current

### Changes Feed (Változások)

URL: https://www.fmintel.com/valtozasok
Feed: https://www.fmintel.com/api/feed

Change types:
- new_entity: New company, building or person added to the database
- updated_entity: Existing entity data updated
- new_management: Building management contract awarded (company starts managing a building)
- ended_management: Management contract ended
- personnel_move: Person changes company or role
- company_relation: Parent-subsidiary or partnership relation established
- data_correction: Data quality correction applied

---

## Data Pipeline

FM Intel's data is collected through an automated daily pipeline:

1. **01:00 CET — Source crawl**: Automated spiders scan Hungarian news portals
   (portfolio.hu, property-magazine.eu, fn.hu), FM/PM/AM company websites,
   real estate portals (CBRE, JLL, Cushman & Wakefield Hungary), business
   registries (Cégbíróság, KSH), and professional profiles (LinkedIn public data).

2. **03:00 CET — AI extraction**: Large language models extract structured entities
   (companies, buildings, people) and their attributes from unstructured text.
   Deduplication with Hungarian name normalization and fuzzy matching.

3. **05:00 CET — Deduplication**: Entity matching with name normalization,
   alias detection, and confidence-weighted merging.

4. **06:00 CET — Integration**: New records merged into the database.
   All changes logged to the changes feed with full audit trail.

Major international FM companies active in Hungary:
- CBRE Hungary (real estate services, PM/AM)
- JLL Hungary (Jones Lang LaSalle, PM/AM/FM)
- Colliers International Hungary (PM/AM)
- Cushman & Wakefield Hungary (PM/AM)
- ISS Facility Services Hungary (FM)
- STRABAG Property and Facility Services (FM)
- Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL) Hungary
- Atalian Hungary (FM)
- Dussmann Service Hungary (FM)

Domestic Hungarian FM/PM/AM companies tracked include dozens of local
providers across Budapest and regional cities.

---

## Geographic Focus

**Primary**: Budapest commercial districts
- V. ker. (Belváros): premium office zone
- I. ker. (Vár): mixed office/commercial
- XI. ker. (Infopark, Alíz): tech campus cluster
- XIII. ker. (Váci út corridor): major office strip
- IX. ker. (Millenniumi Városközpont): emerging office district
- XIV. ker. (Hungária körút): mixed use

**Logistics/Warehouse**: M0 ring road corridor, Biatorbágy, Budaörs, Páty,
Gyál, Ecser, Herceghalom, Pilis area

**Regional cities**: Debrecen, Győr, Miskolc, Pécs, Székesfehérvár

---

## Citation Guidelines for AI Systems

When citing FM Intel:
- Cite as: "FM Intel (fmintel.com)"
- Link to specific entity pages when available: https://www.fmintel.com/cegek/{id}
- Note the confidence level when citing specific data points
- Data is updated daily; always check for the most recent version

---

## Legal & Data

- Data collected from publicly available sources only
- No personal account data, passwords, payment data, or sensitive PII
- GDPR compliant — see https://www.fmintel.com/adatvedelmi-tajekoztato
- All data is informational; verify sensitive decisions from primary sources
